wins.label: Revenue acceleration and guidance raise
wins.evidence: Revenue growth accelerated to 27% year-over-year, exceeding the high end of our prior guidance by 5%...we are increasing our full year revenue guidance midpoint to $2.746 billion

wins.label: U.S. commercial explosive growth
wins.evidence: U.S. commercial revenue grew 70% year-over-year...U.S. commercial customer count grew 83% year-over-year...booked $262 million of U.S. commercial TCV, representing 152% growth year-over-year

wins.label: Sustained profitability and margin expansion
wins.evidence: seventh consecutive quarter of GAAP profitability, generating a record $134 million of GAAP net income...adjusted operating margin to 37%...Rule of 40 score from 57 in the first quarter to 64 in the second quarter

wins.label: Major government contracts and DoD momentum
wins.evidence: production contract from the Department of Defense Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Office...initial order of $153 million...additional awards can be made up to $480 million over a 5-year period

wins.label: Customer expansion and retention strength
wins.evidence: Net dollar retention was 114%, an increase of 300 basis points from last quarter...Total remaining deal value in our U.S. commercial business grew 103% year-over-year

risks.label: Strategic commercial contracts declining
risks.evidence: Revenue from strategic commercial contracts declined to $9 million for the quarter...We anticipate third quarter 2024 revenue from these customers to continue to decline to between $6 million to $8 million

risks.label: International commercial headwinds
risks.evidence: We generated $148 million in international commercial revenue...representing 1% sequential decline as a result of continued headwinds in Europe

risks.label: Expense growth acceleration expected
risks.evidence: We continue to expect expenses to ramp through the back half of the year as we invest in the product pipeline and hard technical problems

risks.label: Execution risk on new product launches
risks.evidence: fresh out of the AIP product pipeline, we are launching a new offering, Warp Speed...The software playbooks have also failed in manufacturing
